nodes.label: Emobilize Design System
nodes.rationale: Visual system for Emobilize. Color tokens come from the shadcn registry @shadcn/theme-neutral, type is Montserrat, and layout units follow the Tailwind scale used by shadcn. Code sources are Shadcn.kt, Palette.kt, Type.kt, Metrics.kt, and Theme.kt.

nodes.label: @shadcn/theme-neutral
nodes.rationale: Upstream registry the palettes copy. Values are stored as HSL, the same way the registry stores them. Hex figures in the tables are sRGB conversions, not the stored form.

nodes.label: Neutral Light
nodes.rationale: Default palette, code name NeutralLight. Status bar and navigation bar are dark on a light background.

nodes.label: Neutral Dark
nodes.rationale: Near-black palette, code name NeutralDark. Status bar and navigation bar are light.

nodes.label: Theme settings
nodes.rationale: Settings offers System, Light, and Dark. The header gear icon opens Settings. The document maps Neutral Light and Neutral Dark but does not say which palette System selects.

nodes.label: Neutral color tokens
nodes.rationale: Shared names across both palettes: background, foreground, card, card-foreground, popover, popover-foreground, primary, primary-foreground, secondary, secondary-foreground, muted, muted-foreground, accent, accent-foreground, destructive, destructive-foreground, border, input, ring, and chart-1 through chart-5. Card and page background use the same color and are separated by a 1 dp border, not by a lighter card fill.

nodes.label: Layer tokens
nodes.rationale: scrim, nav, shadow, and text-subtle. scrim is black at 40 percent in light and 62 percent in dark, over the radial menu and sheets. nav is background at 96 percent light and 97 percent dark for the bottom dock. shadow is black at 6 percent light and 35 percent dark. text-subtle is muted-foreground at 62 percent for completed tasks. Text on a fill uses ink when luminance is above 0.72, otherwise on-dark #FAFAFA.

nodes.label: Product color roles
nodes.rationale: Product colors are not independent. Each role points at a chart token or destructive. Status todo is muted-foreground, progress is chart-1, done is chart-2. Categories: Study chart-1, Work chart-5, Health chart-2, Personal chart-4, University chart-3. Priority low is chart-2, medium chart-4, high destructive. Actions: add primary, update chart-3, edit chart-4, delete destructive. Selected fills are a low alpha of the role color with a stronger stroke.

nodes.label: Chart tokens
nodes.rationale: chart-1 is Study and in-progress, chart-2 is Health, done, and low priority, chart-3 is University and the update action, chart-4 is Personal, medium priority, and the edit action, chart-5 is Work. Light and dark hues differ; light chart-3 is #274754 and dark chart-3 is #E88C30.

nodes.label: Montserrat
nodes.rationale: Font files are montserrat_regular, montserrat_medium, montserrat_semibold, and montserrat_bold. The scale in sp is xs 12/16, sm 14/20, base 16/24, lg 18/28, xl 20/28, 2xl 24/32, 3xl 30/36, 4xl 36/40. Regular is for screen titles and body, Medium for labels, SemiBold for task names and field values, Bold for tabs, filters, chips, and buttons. Section labels are uppercase with about 0.1 em letter-spacing.

nodes.label: shadcn radius scale
nodes.rationale: Base --radius is 0.5rem (8 dp). sm is radius minus 4 (4 dp) for small controls, md is radius minus 2 (6 dp) for chips, badges, and toggles, lg is the radius (8 dp) for buttons, inputs, and date fields, xl is radius plus 4 (12 dp) for task cards and the top corners of sheets. A selected card outer corner is xl plus 4 dp.

nodes.label: Spacing scale
nodes.rationale: Tailwind-like steps in dp: px 1, 1 is 4, 2 is 8, 3 is 12, 4 is 16, 5 is 20, 6 is 24, 8 is 32, 10 is 40. Screen measures already in use: header-horizontal 24, page-horizontal 18, card min height 68, action height 44, nav height 100, fab 88, radial node 48.

nodes.label: Task card
nodes.rationale: Corner xl (12 dp), fill card, 1 dp border when idle, 2 dp action color when selected, elevation from the shadow token.

nodes.label: Sheet
nodes.rationale: Top corners xl, fill popover, 1 dp border, scrim from the layer tokens. The close control is a secondary circle with a secondary-foreground icon.

nodes.label: Input
nodes.rationale: Corner lg, fill background, 1 dp input border, destructive border when invalid, primary cursor, muted-foreground placeholder.

nodes.label: Toggle
nodes.rationale: Corner md. Active state uses primary fill and border with primary-foreground text. Idle state is a transparent fill, a border line, and muted-foreground text.

nodes.label: Chip
nodes.rationale: Corner md. Active fill is the role color and the text follows the luminance rule. Idle fill is the role color at alpha 0x18.

nodes.label: Primary button
nodes.rationale: Height 44 dp, corner lg, fill is the action color, and the label follows the luminance of that fill.

nodes.label: Dock
nodes.rationale: Fill is the nav layer token. The active tab is foreground plus a primary line. The idle tab is muted-foreground. Related measures are nav height 100 dp, fab 88 dp, and radial node 48 dp.

hyperedges.label: Product colors alias chart and destructive tokens
